faq.heading: Common Enquiries
faq.q1: How do I book a Hajj or Umrah transfer?
faq.a1: Book via WhatsApp, our website, or call our 24/7 hotline.
faq.a2: Yes. All drivers hold valid Saudi MOI licenses and Hajj permits.
faq.q3: Which cities and airports do you cover?
faq.a3: Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, Taif, Abha. Airports: KAIA, KFIA, RUH.
faq.q4: Do you offer group rates for families?
faq.a4: Groups of 4+ receive 15% discount. Hajj groups of 10+ get dedicated Coaster.
faq.a5: Free cancellation 2 hours before pickup. Tours: full refund 7 days before.
